claim_statement: The evidential force of an absence depends on the source-to-certificate visibility chain, not on source strength alone.
limitations: The product or operator form is a bookkeeping choice until factor calibration and held-out validation are supplied.
falsifier_or_next_test: Fit alternative visibility models and show whether the conclusion changes under held-out controls.

claim_statement: Natural systems should be typed by their role as transducer, sampler, archive, filter, amplifier, converter, or eraser before being called an instrument.
limitations: The taxonomy is an integration aid and does not imply a shared physical mechanism.
falsifier_or_next_test: Independent reviewers should apply the taxonomy to cases where role assignment changes the inference or reject it as non-informative.

claim_statement: A filament-correlated gamma-ray analysis can be more discriminating than an all-sky excess if it predeclares magnetic proxies, matched void controls, spatial masks, and a held-out score.
disposition: No signal, dark-matter decay, graviton observation, or conversion observation is admitted.
limitations: Run a blinded joint likelihood and require spectral, spatial, field-proxy, and control consistency against ordinary-source baselines.

claim_statement: NWA 13441 supports the methodological caution that a sampled age gap should not be promoted to a Martian magmatism gap without a recovery and selection model.
limitations: The age has disturbance and regression caveats; reservoir-versus-mixing and source-location interpretations remain unresolved.
falsifier_or_next_test: Add independent isotope systems, exposure dating, and additional age-controlled samples; model recovery bias explicitly.

claim_statement: Genesis signatures and present coupling signatures should be archived as separate axes when evaluating a hidden-sector model.
limitations: A two-axis ledger does not supply a viable particle model or abundance calculation.
falsifier_or_next_test: Require one parameter set to satisfy abundance, structure, CMB, propagation, and detector constraints in a held-out joint fit.

claim_statement: A schema-valid visibility record is not a scientific certificate.
limitations: Validation checks type and provenance shape only; it cannot establish source entailment or physical truth.
falsifier_or_next_test: Reject records that label a method-only or uncalibrated result as promoted.
